payload.content: Reese planning proposal: prioritize all STRICT meetings at full windows: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). For SOFT meetings, to avoid overlap penalties, I suggest a non-overlapping chain maximizing shared attendance: m002 [0,1), m006 [2,3), m004 [3,4), m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9), m005 [12,14). I would skip m003, m011, m012. This leaves strict blocks clear and gives at least one-slot overlap opportunities in many group meetings. If others can align with these slots, good joint reward.

Riley planning: I support locking STRICT meetings at full windows m008 [9,10) and m016 [10,11). To avoid overlap penalties, my tentative soft plan is a single-chain similar to Reese's: early block choose one of {m002 [0,1) or m003 [0,1)} then m006 [2,3), m015 [4,5), m009 [7,9), and late choose one of {m005 [12,14) or m007 [11,13)}. I also like m012 [3,4) if people prefer that instead of m006, but not both due overlap. Since m009 overlaps stricts if extended past 9, I'd cap it at [7,9). Please share which exact slots you can match, especially for m002 vs m003, m006 vs m012, and m005 vs m007.

Quinn planning proposal: I will definitely take all STRICT meetings at full windows: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). For SOFT meetings, to avoid overlap penalties I prefer a non-overlapping chain aligned with Reese/Riley: m002 [0,1), m006 [2,3), m004 [3,4), m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9). For the late block, because m010 occupies [11,12), I prefer m005 [12,14) rather than m007 [10,13). I would skip m003, m011, m012, m014, m007 under this plan. If others can match these exact slots, we should get broad overlap with no self-conflict.

Jordan planning proposal: I support taking all STRICT meetings at full windows: m001 [1,2), m008 [9,10), m016 [10,11), m010 [11,12). For SOFT meetings, to avoid overlap penalties and align with Reese/Quinn, my tentative chain is m002 [0,1), m006 [2,3), m004 [3,4), m015 [4,5), m013 [5,7), m009 [7,9). I would skip m012, m014, m011, and m007 under this plan. This leaves no self-overlap and matches the emerging consensus. If anyone prefers swapping m006 for m012 or has a better late plan around m009/stricts, let me know, but current preference is the shared chain above. (phase=planning, iter=1)

If anyone wants a different late-slot coordination, speak up, but I currently favor m005 over m007.
